attestations.text: TSÊNG Kuo-ch'üan 曾國荃 (T. 沅浦, H. 叔純), Oct. 12, 1824–1890, Nov. 13, a native of Hsiang-hsiang, Hunan, and younger brother of Tsêng Kuo-fan [q. v.], was the leading general in the taking of Nanking after it had been eleven years in the hands of the Taiping Rebels.

registry-geography.title: 清史稿 · 卷68 · 湖南
registry-geography.rights: Public-domain historical text; separately applicable Wikisource transcription terms retained.

accounts.evidence: 曾國荃，字沅甫，湖南湘鄉人，大學士國籓之弟也。少負奇氣，從國籓受學京師。咸豐二年，舉優貢。六年，粵匪石達開犯江西，國籓兵不利。國荃欲赴兄急，與新授吉安知府黃冕議，請於湖南巡撫駱秉章，使募勇三千人，別以周鳳山一軍，合六千人，同援江西。十一月，克安福，連破賊於大汾河、千金坡，進攻吉安，下旁數縣。
